senses.gloss: (of circumcision) to trim the preputium, by splitting and drawing it upwards so as to form a sort of pouch around the denuded cone.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 133b:11">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:4">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:4">XVI</cite>), 4 <he>מְהַלְקְטִין וכ׳</he> you must denude the cone &c.

senses.gloss: to fill a bird’s pouch or crop, to stuff.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 155b">Ib. 155ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:4">Tosef. ib. XVIII, 4</cite> distinction between <he>מהלקטין</he> a. <he>מַלְקִיטִין</he> (Hif. of <cite ref="L00677"><he>לָקַט</he></cite>).
